risk_if_not_implemented: Without Risk Ranking, risks may remain unidentified, unowned or unmanaged, leaving decision-makers without a defensible basis for prioritization and treatment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Risk Assessment
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct recurring assessments of risk that includes the likelihood and magnitude of harm, from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification or destruction of the organization's Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD).
compensating_control_1.justification: Risk Assessment (RSK-13) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Risk Ranking (RSK-15) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Monitoring Reporting
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to provide an event log report generation capability to aid in detecting and assessing anomalous activities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Monitoring Reporting (MON-06) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Risk Ranking (RSK-15) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
